twitter_title: The Grind is Real: Ji Ning's Path to Power
twitter_description: Ji Ning trains the ultimate body-refining art, complete with hilarious moments and strategic planning in this classic Xianxia chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme Fiendgod Body Refining divine ability beneath the True God level in the Three Realms. Training it requires mastering nine cycles of body refinement with enormous treasure resources, granting an indestructible body that passively defends without consuming divine power.

A top-ten divine ability in the Three Realms created by the legendary archer Houyi. It is a technique-based art of archery that has surpassed the standard 'Dao of Archery,' requiring immense comprehension to master.

The foundational requirement for entering the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. It allows the cultivator to perfectly transform their body and aura into anything that exists in the Three Realms, from rocks and trees to powerful gods.
A terrifyingly powerful senior disciple of Patriarch Subhuti, known as a 'devil-like' existence with immense karmic sin that manifests as Karmic Hellfire, yet he remains unafraid due to his power.
A cosmic flame that burns a cultivator from the soul if they accumulate too much negative karma through mass slaughter. It is considered a punishment from the Heavens.
The mystical mountain where Patriarch Subhuti resides and teaches his disciples. It is a sanctuary and training ground within the Tristar Crescent Major World.
A core Xianxia trope where a cultivator must balance recruiting a high-karma disciple (rare, already protected) and killing high-sin demons (extremely dangerous, proven survivors).
